    Grow with us

    Moonleaf Tea Shop, an Asian tea brand, is one of the leading and fastest expanding milk tea brands in the Philippines, with over 80 branches placed in key locations nationwide.

     

    All tea shops are operated by Emerald Leaf Franchising Corporation or by its franchisees bound by franchise agreements. Moonleaf operations are strenuously designed to provide consistent and quality service in every branch. Our stringent management system and dynamic team of market analysts, concept designers, and idea generators guarantee that our business flourishes.
